definitions.explanation: The transfer of thermal energy through a material by direct contact between particles, without the material itself moving. A physics and engineering term that also appears in discussions of cookware and building materials.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦フライパン→フライパン：01025_furaipan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{熱伝導|ねつでんどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧、⟦{素早|すばや}く→素早い：17093_subayai⟧⟦{温|あたた}まる→温まる：02095_atatamaru⟧。
examples.english: This frying pan has high thermal conductivity and heats up quickly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{熱伝導|ねつでんどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{速|はや}さ→速さ：28072_hayasa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: The speed of heat conduction differs greatly between metal and wood.

notes:
A scientific term combining ⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧ (heat) and ⟦{伝導|でんどう}→伝導：24991_dendou⟧ (conduction, transmission). Used in physics and engineering, as well as in consumer contexts describing cookware, thermal insulation, and electronics cooling.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {熱伝導|ねつでんどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧ / ⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: has good / poor heat conduction
- {熱伝導|ねつでんどう}{率|りつ}: thermal conductivity (coefficient)
- {熱伝導|ねつでんどう}⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧: thermal conductivity (property)
- {熱伝導|ねつでんどう}⟦シート→シート：10945_shiito⟧: thermal conduction sheet (used in electronics)

RELATED WORDS:
- {対流|たいりゅう}: convection — heat transfer via fluid movement
- ⟦{放射|ほうしゃ}→放射：16334_housha⟧: radiation — heat transfer via electromagnetic waves
- ⟦{断熱|だんねつ}→断熱：06427_dannetsu⟧: heat insulation — blocking heat transfer
